shots.scene: 欣欣拿着一张空白风险评估表，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank risk assessment form and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲风险评估实例与书面记录。
overlay: 风险评估实例与书面记录

shots.scene: 三个案例图标：滴定管、烧杯、乙醚瓶
shots.prompt_en: Three case icons: a burette, a beaker with a stirring rod, and a solvent bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 用几个例子，练一练怎么评估。

shots.scene: 阿杰在实验台前准备稀释浓硫酸
shots.prompt_en: The young male student prepares to dilute a concentrated acid at a lab bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰要稀释浓硫酸，觉得很简单。

shots.scene: 小研递给他评估表，表上有三栏空格
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands him a blank assessment form with three empty columns.
shots.narration: 小研说：先填评估表。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着表格发愣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares at the blank form, puzzled.
shots.narration: 严重程度、可能性，怎么填？

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods at the camera.
shots.narration: 一起来看几个实例。

shots.section_title: 用量和暴露方式决定风险
shots.scene: 一滴酸落在手背，旁边水龙头
shots.prompt_en: A single drop of acid on the back of a gloved hand, next to a running faucet. No faces.
shots.narration: 浓硝酸是强酸，也是强氧化剂。
overlay: 用量和暴露方式决定风险

shots.section_title: 用量和暴露方式决定风险
shots.scene: 一滴好控制，马上冲掉
shots.prompt_en: The single drop is rinsed away immediately under the faucet. No faces.
shots.narration: 一滴好控制，沾到也能马上冲掉。

shots.section_title: 用量和暴露方式决定风险
shots.scene: 一大摊洒在裤腿上的图标，红色警示
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a large spill splashing onto a trouser leg, with a red warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 一大摊洒在腿上，伤害重得多。

shots.section_title: 用量和暴露方式决定风险
shots.scene: 同一瓶酸：锁在柜里打勾，台面上敞开倒酸打叉
shots.prompt_en: Split image: the same acid bottle sealed in a cabinet with a green check, and acid poured on an open bench without a face shield, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 危害没变，变的是用量和暴露方式。

shots.scene: 敞开台面上的乙醚瓶，蒸气飘向人形图标
shots.prompt_en: An open ether bottle on an open bench, with vapor drifting toward a person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 乙醚蒸气，不能随便吸入。

shots.scene: 同一瓶放进通风柜，蒸气被吸走
shots.prompt_en: The same bottle inside a fume hood, its vapor drawn away into the hood. No people.
shots.narration: 放进通风柜，吸入的可能大大降低。

shots.scene: 两个风险指针，一高一低
shots.prompt_en: Two risk dials side by side, one high on the open bench and one low at the fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 在哪儿用，决定了风险高低。

shots.scene: 晴天和雷雨天两幅画面，各一个指针
shots.prompt_en: Two scenes: a sunny day with a low risk dial, and a thunderstorm with a higher risk dial. No people.
shots.narration: 雷电是已知的危害，晴天风险很低。

shots.scene: 雷雨天人在屋里，户外远离大树旗杆
shots.prompt_en: During a thunderstorm a person stays indoors; outside, icons of a tall tree and a flagpole are crossed out.
shots.narration: 雷雨天进屋，远离大树和旗杆。

shots.scene: 实验台前戴好护目镜手套的阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The young male student at a bench wearing goggles, gloves and a lab coat.
shots.narration: 实验室同理，基本防护就能降风险。

shots.section_title: 案例一：往滴定管里倒强酸
shots.scene: 滴定管架得很高，人举过头顶倒液的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of someone pouring liquid into a burette held high above the head, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 案例一：往滴定管里倒强酸。
overlay: 案例一：往滴定管里倒强酸

shots.section_title: 案例一：往滴定管里倒强酸
shots.scene: 评估表：严重程度中到高
shots.prompt_en: A blank assessment form with the severity bar filled to medium-high. No people.
shots.narration: 按浓度，严重程度为中或高。

shots.section_title: 案例一：往滴定管里倒强酸
shots.scene: 器皿和手稳不稳决定可能性
shots.prompt_en: A shaky hand with a big beaker next to a steady hand with a small beaker, and a likelihood bar. No people.
shots.narration: 洒不洒，看器皿和手稳不稳。

shots.section_title: 案例一：往滴定管里倒强酸
shots.scene: 【实拍】把滴定管降到低处，插上小漏斗，用小烧杯缓慢加清水（模拟强酸，戴护目镜手套，手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a burette lowered on its stand below eye level with a small funnel, and a gloved hand pouring slowly from a small beaker.
shots.narration: 用漏斗，把滴定管放低再加液。

shots.section_title: 案例一：往滴定管里倒强酸
shots.scene: 【实拍】小烧杯沿漏斗缓慢倒入，操作者戴护目镜和手套（清水代替，人物不露脸）
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand pours slowly from a small beaker into the funnel; the operator wears safety goggles.
shots.narration: 小烧杯倒，戴好护目镜和手套。

shots.section_title: 案例一：往滴定管里倒强酸
shots.scene: 风险指针从中高降到低
shots.prompt_en: The risk dial drops from medium-high to low. No people.
shots.narration: 中到高的风险，就降下来了。

shots.scene: 浓硫酸瓶，眼睛和皮肤图标红色
shots.prompt_en: A concentrated acid bottle with eye and skin icons in red. No people.
shots.narration: 案例二：稀释浓硫酸，严重程度高。

shots.scene: 评估表：可能性中，总体中到高
shots.prompt_en: A blank assessment form with likelihood medium and overall risk medium-high. No people.
shots.narration: 可能性为中，总体是中到高风险。

shots.scene: 护目镜和耐酸手套
shots.prompt_en: Safety goggles and acid-resistant gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 戴护目镜和耐酸手套，减少暴露。

shots.scene: 欣欣举手示意：等等
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises a paw as if to say wait.
shots.narration: 等等，还漏了一个危害！

shots.scene: 水倒进浓酸、液滴飞溅的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of water being poured into concentrated acid with splashing droplets, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 浓酸遇水大量放热，水倒进酸会飞溅。

shots.scene: 【实拍】沿玻璃棒把有色液体慢慢倒入盛水烧杯并搅拌（有色水模拟，戴护目镜手套，手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a gloved hand slowly pours a liquid along a glass rod into a beaker of water while stirring.
shots.narration: 应把酸慢慢加入水中，边加边搅。

shots.scene: 三个台阶，每个台阶一个问号
shots.prompt_en: Three steps, each marked with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 评估说起来容易，做起来有三个难点。

shots.scene: 毒性、接触限值、闪点三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a toxicity symbol, an exposure gauge and a flame with a thermometer. No people.
shots.narration: 一，严重程度难判断，要懂毒性和闪点。

shots.scene: 新生和毕业生的两个小人，熟练度条不同
shots.prompt_en: Two pictograms, a freshman and a graduate, with different skill bars. No people.
shots.narration: 二，可能性取决于你的经验。

shots.scene: 两个人对同一个指针给出不同判断
shots.prompt_en: Two people point at the same risk dial and give different readings.
shots.narration: 三，多大风险可接受，各人判断不同。

shots.scene: 老周、小研、阿杰一起讨论
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the female graduate student and the young male student discuss together.
shots.narration: 所以要多人讨论，请有经验的人把关。

shots.section_title: 用说明书做实验前评估
shots.scene: 说明书翻开，危害栏亮起
shots.prompt_en: A blank safety data sheet opens with its hazard section highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 看说明书，是为了实验前评估风险。
overlay: 用说明书做实验前评估

shots.section_title: 用说明书做实验前评估
shots.scene: 两瓶不相容的试剂被分开，中间一道隔板
shots.prompt_en: Two incompatible reagent bottles are separated by a divider. No people.
shots.narration: 查清不相容物，别让它们碰在一起。

shots.section_title: 用说明书做实验前评估
shots.scene: 回流装置旁三个问号：放热、放气、易燃
shots.prompt_en: A reflux apparatus with three question marks: heat release, gas release, and a flammable solvent. No people.
shots.narration: 会不会剧烈放热、放气？溶剂易燃吗？

shots.section_title: 用说明书做实验前评估
shots.scene: 阿杰写好防护和应急措施
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes protection and emergency measures into a blank form.
shots.narration: 想好防护和应急，再动手。

shots.section_title: 危险化学品先做危害分析
shots.scene: 一瓶会剧烈反应的试剂，旁边放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle that reacts violently, with a magnifying glass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 会剧烈反应的危险化学品，先做危害分析。
overlay: 危险化学品先做危害分析

shots.section_title: 危险化学品先做危害分析
shots.scene: 老周和王老师一起分析
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the safety administrator analyze a blank chart together.
shots.narration: 请懂行的人一起分析。

shots.section_title: 危险化学品先做危害分析
shots.scene: 火焰和爆炸图标，旁边严重程度条
shots.prompt_en: Fire and explosion icons with a severity bar. No people.
shots.narration: 可能怎么着火爆炸？后果多严重？

shots.section_title: 危险化学品先做危害分析
shots.scene: 四个图标：物质、用量和距离、房间、人
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a molecule, a scale with distance arrows, a room outline and a person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 看物质、用量距离、房间和人，查事故教训。

shots.scene: 一张风险评估表，栏目图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: A blank risk assessment form with column icons lighting up: a hazard, a person, a dial, a shield and a signature. No people.
shots.narration: 风险评估表，各栏要填清楚。

shots.scene: 无护栏高处坠落，只做培训，表上仍为高风险红色
shots.prompt_en: On the form, a fall-from-height row is marked red even though a training icon is added. No people.
shots.narration: 只靠培训，风险可能仍然很高。

shots.scene: 加装护栏后，表上变为绿色
shots.prompt_en: After a guard rail icon is added, the row turns green. No people.
shots.narration: 加了硬措施，可能性降下来，变低风险。

shots.scene: 表格最后一栏写负责人，签名处
shots.prompt_en: The last column of the form shows a person icon and a signature line. No people.
shots.narration: 最后写明由谁落实、何时完成。

shots.scene: 表格中“出事怎么办”一栏和急救箱
shots.prompt_en: A form section with a first aid kit icon for emergency actions. No people.
shots.narration: 万一出事怎么处理，也要写进去。

shots.section_title: 评估要成文、审批、人人知晓
shots.scene: 脑袋里的想法变成纸上的表格
shots.prompt_en: A thought bubble turns into a written blank form on paper. No people.
shots.narration: 没写下来的评估，等于没评估。
overlay: 评估要成文、审批、人人知晓

shots.section_title: 评估要成文、审批、人人知晓
shots.scene: 老周签字，王老师审批盖章
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs the form, then the safety administrator stamps it.
shots.narration: 负责人审核，高风险报学院审批。

shots.section_title: 评估要成文、审批、人人知晓
shots.scene: 抽屉里落灰的表格被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A form locked away gathering dust in a drawer, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 锁在抽屉里没人看，等于白做。

shots.section_title: 评估要成文、审批、人人知晓
shots.scene: 老周给大家讲解评估结果，每人签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man explains the assessment to the team, and each person signs the form.
shots.narration: 结果讲给每个参与的人，签字确认。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问，小研解答
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises a hand to ask a question, and the female graduate student answers.
shots.narration: 评估不是老师一个人的事。

shots.scene: 阿杰看懂后签字
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nods and signs the form after understanding it.
shots.narration: 做实验的人要参与，看懂再签字。

shots.scene: 阿杰翻看上次的实验记录，头上一个问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student flips through his last lab notebook with a question mark over his head.
shots.narration: 回头想想：上次实验漏了什么危险？

shots.section_title: 复现别人的实验也要先评估
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着别人的实验报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds someone else's blank lab report.
shots.narration: 想照别人的报告复现实验？
overlay: 复现别人的实验也要先评估

shots.section_title: 复现别人的实验也要先评估
shots.scene: 评估表和本室设备清单对照
shots.prompt_en: A blank assessment form compared with a checklist of the lab's own equipment. No people.
shots.narration: 先评估，看本室条件够不够。

shots.section_title: 复现别人的实验也要先评估
shots.scene: 老周点头同意，旁边审批章
shots.prompt_en: The older man nods in approval next to an approval stamp icon.
shots.narration: 导师和负责人同意了，再做。

shots.section_title: 评估风险是你将来的责任
shots.scene: 教学实验台上已设计好的实验卡片
shots.prompt_en: A teaching lab bench with a pre-designed experiment card. No people.
shots.narration: 课程实验，大多已有人评估过。
overlay: 评估风险是你将来的责任

shots.section_title: 评估风险是你将来的责任
shots.scene: 阿杰穿上科研实验服，自己拿起评估表
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, now in a research lab, picks up a blank assessment form himself.
shots.narration: 做科研时，评估就是你的责任。

shots.scene: 一滴和一摊、台面和通风柜
shots.prompt_en: Two pairs of icons: a drop versus a puddle, and an open bench versus a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 用量和场所，决定风险高低。

shots.scene: 酸入水的图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A green check next to an icon of acid being added slowly into water with stirring. No people.
shots.narration: 评估时回头查，有没有漏掉危害。

shots.scene: 填好的表格、签名、每人签字
shots.prompt_en: A completed blank form with signatures from the team. No people.
shots.narration: 写成文、经审批、人人知晓、定期复查。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张拆成步骤的作业卡挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank task card split into steps and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲工作危害分析。
